title: Library Shelf Quest
focus: Count both groups of books together to find a total within 10.

quiz.context: There are 2 books on a shelf, and Aina adds 2 more books; how many books are on the shelf now?
There are 3 books in a basket, and Ravi adds 5 more books; how many books are in the basket now?
There are 4 books on a desk, and Mei adds 5 more books; how many books are on the desk now?

title: Hawker Stall Basket Trail
focus: Start with the larger group and count on to add within 10.

quiz.context: A hawker places 5 bowls on a counter and then adds 1 more bowl; how many bowls are on the counter now?
A hawker has 6 cups on a tray and puts 2 more cups on it; how many cups are on the tray now?
There are 7 spoons in a holder, and a hawker adds 2 more spoons; how many spoons are in the holder now?

title: Fruit Market Ten Frame
focus: Split the second group to complete 10 before counting the remaining fruit.

quiz.context: A fruit seller has 9 oranges in a basket and adds 3 more oranges; how many oranges are in the basket now?
There are 8 mangoes on a tray, and a seller adds 5 more mangoes; how many mangoes are on the tray now?
A seller puts 7 bananas beside another 9 bananas; how many bananas are there altogether?

title: Batik Pattern Studio
focus: Keep the ten in a teen number and add to its ones without crossing 20.

quiz.context: A batik pattern has 12 circles, and Siti draws 3 more circles; how many circles are in the pattern now?
A batik pattern has 14 leaves, and Bala adds 2 more leaves; how many leaves are in the pattern now?
A batik pattern has 16 dots, and Hana draws 3 more dots; how many dots are in the pattern now?

title: School Courtyard Flag Lines
focus: Add whole tens by counting bundles of 10 flags.

quiz.context: One school flag line has 20 flags and another line has 10 flags; how many flags are on both lines altogether?
Pupils hang 30 flags in the courtyard and then hang 30 more flags; how many flags do they hang altogether?
There are 40 flags along a path, and pupils add 30 more flags; how many flags are along the path now?

title: Neighbourhood Bookshop Delivery
focus: Add tens to tens and ones to ones when neither column needs regrouping.

quiz.context: A bookshop has 23 exercise books and receives 14 more exercise books; how many exercise books does it have now?
A bookshop has 34 pencils and receives 22 more pencils; how many pencils does it have now?
A bookshop has 51 erasers and receives 28 more erasers; how many erasers does it have now?

title: School Garden Plant Markers
focus: Keep the tens unchanged while adding a one-digit number without regrouping.

quiz.context: There are 43 plant markers in a school garden, and pupils add 5 more markers; how many markers are in the garden now?
Pupils have labelled 62 pots and then label 4 more pots; how many pots have they labelled altogether?
There are 81 seed packets in a box, and pupils add 7 more packets; how many seed packets are in the box now?

title: Kuih Tray Number Bridge
focus: Make the next ten when adding ones, then count the remaining ones.

quiz.context: A stall has 18 pieces of kuih on a tray and adds 5 more pieces; how many pieces of kuih are on the tray now?
A baker puts 27 paper cases in a box and adds 6 more cases; how many paper cases are in the box now?
A stall has 36 small plates and receives 7 more plates; how many plates does the stall have now?

title: Classroom Toy Tidy-Up
focus: Remove objects from a group and count how many remain within 10.

quiz.context: There are 6 toy cars on a mat, and pupils put 2 cars in a box; how many toy cars remain on the mat?
There are 8 blocks on a table, and pupils put 3 blocks away; how many blocks remain on the table?
There are 9 toy animals on a shelf, and pupils move 2 animals to a basket; how many toy animals remain on the shelf?

title: Badminton Equipment Trail
focus: Count back one step for each item removed to subtract within 10.

quiz.context: A badminton club has 8 rackets on a rack, and players take 2 rackets; how many rackets remain on the rack?
There are 9 shuttlecocks in a basket, and players take 5 shuttlecocks; how many shuttlecocks remain in the basket?
There are 10 training cones in a bag, and a coach takes out 3 cones; how many cones remain in the bag?

title: Reading Corner Compare Quest
focus: Subtract the smaller count from the larger count to find how many more.

quiz.context: The reading corner has 13 storybooks and 3 picture dictionaries; how many more storybooks than picture dictionaries are there?
One shelf has 16 books and another shelf has 5 books; how many more books are on the first shelf?
A class has 18 bookmarks and 7 book stands; how many more bookmarks than book stands does it have?

title: Community Hall Lantern Pack
focus: Remove one group of 10 from a teen number to see the ones that remain.

quiz.context: There are 12 paper lanterns in a box, and volunteers hang 10 lanterns; how many paper lanterns remain in the box?
There are 16 ribbon strips on a table, and volunteers use 10 strips; how many ribbon strips remain on the table?
There are 18 paper flowers in a basket, and volunteers display 10 flowers; how many paper flowers remain in the basket?

title: School Bus Tens Route
focus: Subtract whole tens by removing groups of 10 from the starting count.

quiz.context: There are 50 bus tickets in a folder, and a teacher hands out 20 tickets; how many tickets remain in the folder?
There are 70 route cards in a box, and a teacher takes 30 cards; how many route cards remain in the box?
There are 80 seat labels in a packet, and staff use 20 labels; how many seat labels remain in the packet?

title: Art Room Supply Sort
focus: Subtract ones from ones and tens from tens when no regrouping is needed.

quiz.context: An art room has 46 sheets of coloured paper, and pupils use 23 sheets; how many sheets remain?
There are 58 crayons in a box, and pupils take 24 crayons; how many crayons remain in the box?
There are 79 craft sticks in a jar, and pupils use 36 sticks; how many craft sticks remain in the jar?

title: Beach Clean-Up Count
focus: Keep the tens unchanged while subtracting a one-digit number from the ones.

quiz.context: Volunteers have 47 gloves in a supply box and take out 3 gloves; how many gloves remain in the box?
Volunteers have 68 collection bags and hand out 5 bags; how many collection bags remain?
There are 89 sorting labels in a packet, and volunteers use 7 labels; how many labels remain in the packet?

title: Kite Workshop Ten Exchange
focus: Exchange one ten for 10 ones when there are too few ones to subtract.

quiz.context: A kite workshop has 23 paper sheets, and pupils use 6 sheets; how many paper sheets remain?
There are 32 ribbon strips in a tray, and pupils use 5 strips; how many ribbon strips remain in the tray?
There are 41 bamboo sticks in a bundle, and pupils take 7 sticks; how many bamboo sticks remain in the bundle?

title: School Shoe Pair Parade
focus: Count equal groups of 2 by skip-counting in twos.

quiz.context: There are 3 pairs of shoes on a rack, with 2 shoes in each pair; how many shoes are on the rack altogether?
There are 6 pairs of slippers, with 2 slippers in each pair; how many slippers are there altogether?
There are 4 pairs of sports shoes, with 2 shoes in each pair; how many sports shoes are there altogether?

title: Paper Flower Display
focus: Connect repeated addition of 5 to equal groups and skip-counting in fives.

quiz.context: Pupils make 2 paper flowers with 5 petals on each flower; how many petals do the flowers have altogether?
There are 3 display cards with 5 paper flowers on each card; how many paper flowers are displayed altogether?
Pupils fill 4 trays with 5 paper leaves in each tray; how many paper leaves are in the trays altogether?

title: Pencil Sharing Partners
focus: Share objects one at a time between 2 equal groups and count each group.

quiz.context: A teacher shares 6 pencils equally between 2 pupils; how many pencils does each pupil receive?
A teacher shares 10 erasers equally between 2 pupils; how many erasers does each pupil receive?
A teacher shares 16 crayons equally between 2 pupils; how many crayons does each pupil receive?

title: Garden Club Sharing Circle
focus: Share a total equally among 5 groups and check that every group has the same count.

quiz.context: Garden club pupils share 10 seeds equally among 5 pots; how many seeds go in each pot?
Garden club pupils share 15 plant markers equally among 5 trays; how many plant markers go in each tray?
Garden club pupils share 20 seed packets equally among 5 teams; how many seed packets does each team receive?
